messages:
Anna (CS): Need a compact 'micro go-live' playbook for small/mid-market customers: must fit in a message we can paste into their runbook. Focus: caching, batching, streaming fallback, one-click mitigations, and a 24h feedback ask.

Mike (SRE): I'll keep the ops bits tiny: 3 checks and 3 recovery actions.

Lina (PM): Recommend: readiness checks, immediate remedies, pasteable config, and simple feedback signal that maps to CRM.

Anna (CS): Draft below (copyable):

"Micro Go‑Live — 6‑minute checklist"
1) Quick readiness (2 min)
 - Confirm model pinned (ask CS for exact id).
 - Enable prefix cache (TTL=600s) for repeated greetings or IDs.
 - Start with batching: target_batch_size=10, max_latency_ms=120; streaming=on.
2) Immediate remedies (if you see problems)
 - Step 1 (first 5m): increase cache TTL to 1200s and recheck cache_hit_rate.
 - Step 2 (next 10m): if latency still high, disable streaming for that route and reduce target_batch_size by ~50%.
 - Safety: errors >1% for 5m -> switch to fallback_model=redwood-lite-v1 and notify your CS rep.
3) Pasteable SDK config:
 {"model":"redwood-boost-1","prefill_cache":{"enabled":true,"ttl_seconds":600},"batching":{"target_batch_size":10,"max_latency_ms":120},"streaming":true}
4) 24h feedback ask (one line to send customers):
 "Any latency spikes or wrong quality? Reply with route + sample input. If No, tell us expected peak users/day so we can recommend capacity."

Evan (Customer): Helpful. Add a one-line rule: when to bump TTL vs add prefill items.

Anna (CS): One-liner for customers: "Increase TTL when many sessions reuse the same prompts; add prefill entries when short, deterministic text (greetings, product codes) appears at session start and can be stored verbatim."

Mike (SRE): Internal quick PromQL checks to include in CS->SRE handoff:
 - rate(redwood_infer_requests_total[5m]) by (route)
 - histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_infer_response_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
 - sum(rate(redwood_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_cache_lookup_total[5m]))

Anna (CS): CRM mapping: if customer answers No to latency OK OR quality OK in the 24h pulse, set renewal_risk=true and open a priority follow-up.

Lina (PM): I'll add this micro playbook to the onboarding kit and a compact PDF.
